## Purpose

An `*Item` struct is one element of a JSON array a `pipeline/` command emits, where the array's overall ORDER is meaningful (dependency level, wave sequence) and must be byte-stable across runs. `DispatchItem` (dispatch_plan.rs) is the clearest exemplar: one entry per agent to dispatch, sorted `(level, wave)`, carrying everything the orchestrator needs including a ready-to-run `prompt_cmd`. `wave_advance.rs` and `pipeline_summary.rs` build similar per-row shapes feeding a deterministic array or report.

## Convention

Folder: apps/rt/src/commands/pipeline/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 3

Item fields use `#[serde(rename = "...")]` to keep the wire JSON in `snake_case` while the Rust field may differ (`depends_on`, `prompt_cmd`, `subagent_type`), and every field's doc-comment states not just what the value is but how the CALLER must treat it (e.g. "the orchestrator runs this and passes the stdout ... it must NOT treat this string as the prompt itself"). Items derive `Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq` for exact-match testing.

## How to apply

Define one `pub struct FooItem` per emitted row, deriving `Serialize` with explicit `rename`s for any field whose Rust name would not match the wire contract. Build the array via a pure function (`build_plan`) that sorts deterministically before returning, and keep any "this array's order encodes X" invariant stated in a field or module doc-comment, not implied.

## Examples

Ref: apps/rt/src/commands/pipeline/dispatch_plan.rs

```rust
/// One dispatch item — a single agent the orchestrator will fan out.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DispatchItem {
    /// 1-based wave number (matches the `wave-N-{role}` directory).
    pub wave: u32,
    /// Role token (the `{role}` suffix of `wave-N-{role}`).
    pub role: String,
    /// Wave numbers this wave depends on, ascending. Empty when independent.
    #[serde(rename = "depends_on")]
    pub depends_on: Vec<u32>,
    /// Topological depth. Items sharing a level are dispatch-parallel.
    pub level: u32,
}
```
